title: hieracium maculatum subsp. inquinatum
intro: Hieracium maculatum subsp. inquinatum, commonly known as spotted hawk's beard, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and improving digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium maculatum subsp. inquinatum include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using this plant for medicinal purposes.
